summary: On macOS an Alt-modified character typed into a stui terminal tab reaches the child as Escape followed by the character, as it does on Linux

replay.detail: No replay; no stored data or projection changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and fleet coordination are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: On macOS only: a terminal tab child that expects the legacy Escape prefix for Alt now receives it. No protocol or API change; Linux is unchanged.

recovery.detail: Nothing is persisted; swapping to the previous binary needs no step.
